author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I have spent the last three weeks chasing down which version of the demand model actually generated last Tuesday's allocation errors. The current process is a mess of manual notes and scattered scripts that no one trusts. I want the model registry to be fully automated so that every deployment is traceable and reproducible. I need to see the exact data snapshot, hyperparameters, and evaluation metrics linked to every single release without digging through old emails. The more complete and automated this registry becomes, the better our ability to diagnose drift and prove to the buyers that our numbers are sound. I am looking for a system that captures everything by default, leaving no room for human error in the versioning chain.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement explicitly expresses a desire for increased completeness and automation ('The more complete and automated this registry becomes, the better...'), indicating that doing more than the minimum requested would increase satisfaction.
